description: Default enterprise goal targets for a professional services firm. Adjust targets to match the specific deployment.

goals.label: Annual Revenue
goals.notes: Top-line revenue target. Tracked against invoices issued and collected.

goals.label: Project Margin
goals.notes: Average gross margin across all active projects. Tracked against budget vs actuals.

goals.label: Client NPS
goals.notes: Net Promoter Score from quarterly client feedback surveys.

goals.label: Delivery SLA Adherence
goals.notes: % of milestones delivered on or before due date. Tracked per project by PROJECT_HEALTH agent.

goals.label: Employee Utilization
goals.notes: Billable hours as % of available hours. Tracked against task assignments.
